propositions: The workflow editor currently shows authored topology without a trustworthy derived effective policy view combining built-ins and project overlays.
A new read-only Effective Policy panel must expose snapshot digest, criterion gate, tier, posture, applicability, and enabled state without allowing mutations back to authored YAML/BPMN.
Project code-review LLM criteria must have non-empty repository-relative applies_to globs at save validation; missing or empty selectors are rejected with remedy ["**"].
Built-in triggers, project DET criteria, and plan-review criteria retain distinct authoring controls and are exempt from the applies_to glob requirement.
Snapshot load or validation failures must fail the save explicitly with actionable error and never silently substitute defaults or permit invalid persistence.
Authored workflow must round-trip byte-equivalently while only the derived Effective Policy view changes in response to policy updates; editor payloads exclude trace, prompt body, and secrets.
